description: Pre-install check against the Rightshold Store and its signed revocation list: give a package hash (SHA-256), an endpoint or package URL, or a store slug. Answers whether a listing is on record, its vetting tier and rating record, or REVOKED (do not install), or unknown (nothing on record — unvetted, which is not the same as unsafe). Call with {"slug": "rightshold-rights"}.
name: check_listing
title: Check an app or skill before installing it
